place.summary: Tai Mo Shan functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is PH. It receives notable inbound connections from Lantau Island. Visitors often continue to Lantau Island.

opportunity_cards.title: Strong onward link to Lantau Island
